definition.proposition: At 200M tokens of code-py-v2, the assembled recipe A2s (GDN hybrid, shared core of 6 blocks x 2 passes with fixed r and full backprop, ternary core with full-precision prelude/coda/inject, contractive injection) beats the naive full fusion E27 by about 17% in clean80 bpc while using about 10% more training compute (3.79e16 vs 3.41-3.43e16 FLOPs per run).

scope.dataset: code-py-v2, clean80 doc-level bpc (v1 val, K9 overlap < 0.8)

definition.refutation_criteria: REFUTED if a replication on fresh seeds or a longer horizon (SQ380) puts the paired 95% CI of A2s - E27 at or above -5%

origin.source: A2 (registered P1, PREDICTIONS.md 'A2 assembled model'); reworded after claim audit 2026-11-23-1404

qual: 3 fresh seeds, registered, 200M, clean80; compute stated

LR: E27's 6e-3 is bracketed (v0.5.13); A2s is the untuned winner, so a better A2s LR could only enlarge the effect. limitations.text: Recipe-level claim only: the A1 one-change effects behind the stack are exploratory (2 seeds) and confounded inside it. Single horizon (200M; SQ380 tests 600M), in-corpus clean80 only (SQ379 out of corpus). A2f vs E24 shows the assembled loop model still trails an unshared GDN stack by 3.2%.

limitations.text: The fixed-r comparator check (event 8, A2s vs A1a -12.56%) is exploratory: post hoc, unregistered, unpaired across different seed sets (A1a seeds 0-1 are A1's selection seeds). It bounds how much of the headline the fixed-r choice could explain; it is not a confirmatory test.

Not parameter-matched: A2s has about 15.1M unique non-embedding params vs E27 and A1a about 9.5M (the A1g 6x2 shape adds unique params by design). The -16.7% (and -12.6% vs A1a) therefore includes a unique-parameter effect, which C197 says is large at matched FLOPs, so 'mostly the assembly' (v0.5.39) is not shown. SQ419 (F-6: E27's recipe on the 6-block core) separates shape and unique params from the compensations.
